_about: What the approver's page shows for a G17 periodic software evaluation. One file per form (user, 2026-10-07): change this file to change what the page shows - no code change. Read by IRSTasks through the `fields` key of the IRSPeriodicSoftwareEvaluation entry in js/config/TaskFields.js (DOCUMENT_TYPES). The G17 route approves the evaluation object itself; the page reads it through our REST JAR, `GET resources/v1/irsproject/evaluations/{id}` (worklog 2026-10-21-12).
